B1L13-G01-P295.title: Complete the following dialogues with “Reduplicated Action V(一)V” pattern.

segments.traditional: 我覺得這本書很有趣，你要不要
segments.simplified: 我觉得这本书很有趣，你要不要

repairs.note: B answers 我也看過: a book is read, so the light action is 看看, not 聽聽.
一 needs the verb on both sides (看一看); with two blanks, just double the verb: 看看.
要不要 already makes the question; after it comes the light action 看看, not 看不.

items.fallbackRepair: Double the verb for a light, easy action: 看看.

result.traditional: 我覺得這本書很有趣，你要不要看看？
result.simplified: 我觉得这本书很有趣，你要不要看看？
result.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè běn shū hěn yǒuqù, nǐ yào bu yào kàn kan?
result.english: I think this book is really interesting. Do you want to take a look?

segments.traditional: 你下課以後，常常做什麼？
segments.simplified: 你下课以后，常常做什么？

repairs.note: 常常 talks about a habit, so no 了; the light action is 上上網.
一 needs the same verb on both sides (看一看); with verb + object 上網, double only 上: 上上網.
上網 is verb + object, so only the verb doubles: 上 + 上網 = 上上網.

items.fallbackRepair: Double the verb, then the object: 上上網.

result.traditional: 我常常在家上上網，不太出去。
result.simplified: 我常常在家上上网，不太出去。
result.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng zài jiā shàng shang wǎng, bú tài chūqù.
result.english: I usually stay home and go online; I don’t go out much.

segments.traditional: 我們可以去百貨公司做什麼？
segments.simplified: 我们可以去百货公司做什么？

repairs.note: B doesn’t want to buy anything (我不想買), so they just look: 看一看衣服.
B is suggesting something to do, so put 一 between the verbs: 看一看; 了 is for something already done.

items.fallbackRepair: Verb, 一, the same verb, then the object: 看一看衣服.

result.traditional: 我們可以看一看衣服，可是我不想買。
result.simplified: 我们可以看一看衣服，可是我不想买。
result.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ kàn yi kàn yīfu, kěshì wǒ bù xiǎng mǎi.
result.english: We can have a look at clothes, but I don’t want to buy anything.

B1L13-G02-P296.title: Describe the following pictures with 從……往……。

scene.alt: A man with a camera at the foot of Taipei 101, looking up.

segments.traditional: 看，我覺得台北101真的好高。
segments.simplified: 看，我觉得台北101真的好高。

repairs.note: Look at the picture: he stands at the foot of the tower and looks up, not out: 從這裡往上看.
Look at the picture: he stands outside at the foot of the tower and looks 往上.

items.fallbackRepair: He stands at the bottom: 從 + where he is (這裡), then 往 + the direction (上), then 看.

result.traditional: 從這裡往上看，我覺得台北101真的好高。
result.simplified: 从这里往上看，我觉得台北101真的好高。
result.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ wǎng shàng kàn, wǒ juéde Táiběi Yīlíngyī zhēn de hǎo gāo.
result.english: Looking up from here, I think Taipei 101 is really tall.

scene.alt: A woman looks out of a car window at the houses.

repairs.note: Look at the picture: she looks out of the side window at the houses, not up: 往外.
Look at the picture: she looks out of the side window, not ahead: 往外.

items.fallbackRepair: She is inside the car: 從車裡, then 往外, then 看.

result.traditional: 從車裡往外看，房子很小，很有趣。
result.simplified: 从车里往外看，房子很小，很有趣。
result.pinyin: Cóng chē lǐ wǎng wài kàn, fángzi hěn xiǎo, hěn yǒuqù.
result.english: Looking out from the car, the houses are small; it’s fun.

scene.alt: A map: a road between the school and the post office, a person walking on it and a cat by the road.

repairs.note: Look at the map: there is no bank; the road runs between the school and the post office.
去 is the verb “go”; the direction you walk takes 往: 往郵局走.

items.fallbackRepair: 從 + where you start, 往 + where you head, then 走: 從學校往郵局走.

result.traditional: 從學校往郵局走，你會看到一隻貓。
result.simplified: 从学校往邮局走，你会看到一只猫。
result.pinyin: Cóng xuéxiào wǎng yóujú zǒu, nǐ huì kàndào yì zhī māo.
result.english: Walk from the school toward the post office and you’ll see a cat.

alternatives.traditional: 從郵局往學校走，你會看到一隻貓。
alternatives.simplified: 从邮局往学校走，你会看到一只猫。
alternatives.pinyin: Cóng yóujú wǎng xuéxiào zǒu, nǐ huì kàndào yì zhī māo.
alternatives.english: Walk from the post office toward the school and you’ll see a cat.

B1L13-G03-P297.title: Complete the following dialogues with 就.

segments.traditional: 我今天很早就到學校來了。
segments.simplified: 我今天很早就到学校来了。

repairs.note: 也 means “also”, but nobody else is mentioned; A says seven is early, so 就.
A has already arrived (到學校來了), so not 會; 就 marks seven o’clock as early.

items.fallbackRepair: Time first, then 就, then the verb and 了: 七點就到了.

result.traditional: 我七點就到了。
result.simplified: 我七点就到了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ qī diǎn jiù dào le.
result.english: I was already here at seven.

segments.traditional: 我想去台北101，請問要怎麼走？
segments.simplified: 我想去台北101，请问要怎么走？

repairs.note: 也 means “also”, but walking forward is the only step; the easy result takes 就.
再 is for a next step you plan; the easy result of 往前走 takes 就.
B is telling A what A will see, so 你.

items.fallbackRepair: 就 goes after the subject and before 可以: 你就可以看到.

result.traditional: 往前走，你就可以看到台北101了。
result.pinyin: Wǎng qián zǒu, nǐ jiù kěyǐ kàndào Táiběi Yīlíngyī le.
result.english: Walk straight ahead and you’ll see Taipei 101.

segments.traditional: 我明天要跟同學介紹我的國家，所以想到圖書館去找書。
segments.simplified: 我明天要跟同学介绍我的国家，所以想到图书馆去找书。

repairs.note: 再 is for a next step you plan; the easy result after searching online takes 就.
在 marks an action going on; the easy result after searching online takes 就可以.
想 is what you want; B says it’s easy to find online: 就可以找到了.

items.fallbackRepair: 就 comes first, then 可以: 就可以找到了.

result.traditional: 你上網找一找，就可以找到了。
result.simplified: 你上网找一找，就可以找到了。
result.pinyin: Nǐ shàngwǎng zhǎo yi zhǎo, jiù kěyǐ zhǎodào le.
result.english: Just look online and you’ll find it.

B1L13-G04-P303.title: Complete the following sentences with 就（要）……了.

repairs.note: 快要 can’t follow a set time like 明天; with a time word use 就要…了.
The exam is tomorrow, still to come, so not 已經; soon after a time word is 就要…了.

items.fallbackRepair: Time word, 就要, the event, 了 at the end: 明天就要考試了.

result.traditional: 明天就要考試了，你不緊張嗎？
result.simplified: 明天就要考试了，你不紧张吗？
result.pinyin: Míngtiān jiù yào kǎoshì le, nǐ bù jǐnzhāng ma?
result.english: The exam is tomorrow. Aren’t you nervous?

repairs.note: 快要 can’t follow a set time like 下星期二; with a time word use 就要…了.
會 doesn’t go with this 了; for something coming up at a set time use 就要…了.

items.fallbackRepair: Subject, time word, 就要, the event, 了: 她下星期二就要回國了.

result.traditional: 她下星期二就要回國了，我想送她一個禮物。
result.simplified: 她下星期二就要回国了，我想送她一个礼物。
result.pinyin: Tā xià xīngqī’èr jiù yào huíguó le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge lǐwù.
result.english: She’s going back to her country next Tuesday; I want to give her a present.

repairs.note: 以前 points back in time; “in ten minutes” is 十分鐘以後.
快要 can’t follow a set time like 十分鐘以後; with a time word use 就要…了.

items.fallbackRepair: Time word (十分鐘以後), then 就要, the event 來, and 了.

result.traditional: 火車十分鐘以後就要來了，他們怎麼還沒到？
result.simplified: 火车十分钟以后就要来了，他们怎么还没到？
result.pinyin: Huǒchē shí fēnzhōng yǐhòu jiù yào lái le, tāmen zěnme hái méi dào?
result.english: The train is coming in ten minutes. Why aren’t they here yet?

B1L13-G05-P304.title: Rearrange the following sentences. / Rewrite the following sentences with pattern A or B.

repairs.note: 跑 has no object here, so the time comes straight after it: 跑半個小時, no 的.

items.fallbackRepair: Who and when first, then the verb, then how long: 他每天跑半個小時.

result.traditional: 他每天跑半個小時。
result.simplified: 他每天跑半个小时。
result.pinyin: Tā měitiān pǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí.
result.english: He runs for half an hour every day.

alternatives.pinyin: Měitiān tā pǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí.
alternatives.english: Every day he runs for half an hour.

repairs.note: 十分 is a clock time (九點十分); a length of time needs 分鐘: 十分鐘.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb first, then how long: 我需要休息十分鐘.

result.traditional: 我需要休息十分鐘。
result.simplified: 我需要休息十分钟。
result.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào xiūxi shí fēnzhōng.
result.english: I need to rest for ten minutes.

alternatives.english: I need ten minutes to rest.

repairs.note: 睡覺 is verb + object, so the time can’t follow it; use 睡 + 十分鐘.
A yes/no request with 可以 ends with 嗎, not 呢.

items.fallbackRepair: 先 before the verb, the time after it, 嗎 at the end: 可以先睡十分鐘嗎？

result.traditional: 我現在太累了，可以先睡十分鐘嗎？
result.simplified: 我现在太累了，可以先睡十分钟吗？
result.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài tài lèi le, kěyǐ xiān shuì shí fēnzhōng ma?
result.english: I’m too tired right now. Can I sleep for ten minutes first?

segments.traditional: 他每天都走路走半個鐘頭。
segments.simplified: 他每天都走路走半个钟头。

repairs.note: Pattern B splits 走路: 走 + time + 的 + 路.
得 links a verb to a comment; the time joins the object 路 with 的.

items.fallbackRepair: Pattern B: verb, time, 的, object: 走半個鐘頭的路.

result.traditional: 他每天都走半個鐘頭的路。
result.simplified: 他每天都走半个钟头的路。
result.pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu zǒu bàn ge zhōngtóu de lù.
result.english: He walks for half an hour every day.

segments.traditional: 我一個星期要上班上五天。
segments.simplified: 我一个星期要上班上五天。

repairs.note: Pattern B splits 上班: 上 + time + 的 + 班.
This is a regular schedule (要, every week), so no 了; join 五天 to 班 with 的.

items.fallbackRepair: Pattern B: verb, time, 的, object: 上五天的班.

result.traditional: 我一個星期要上五天的班。
result.simplified: 我一个星期要上五天的班。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yí ge xīngqī yào shàng wǔ tiān de bān.
result.english: I work five days a week.

segments.traditional: 我想上兩個月的華語課。
segments.simplified: 我想上两个月的华语课。

repairs.note: That is the sentence you started with (pattern B); rewrite it with pattern A: repeat the verb, no 的.
A length of months needs 個: 兩個月.

items.fallbackRepair: Pattern A: verb + object, the verb again, then the time: 上華語課上兩個月.

result.traditional: 我想上華語課上兩個月。
result.simplified: 我想上华语课上两个月。
result.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shàng Huáyǔ kè shàng liǎng ge yuè.
result.english: I want to take Chinese classes for two months.

segments.traditional: 我明天要坐十六個小時的飛機。
segments.simplified: 我明天要坐十六个小时的飞机。

repairs.note: 開飛機 means flying the plane as the pilot; the sentence is about riding it: 坐.
Pattern A has no 的: verb + object, the verb again, then the time.

items.fallbackRepair: Pattern A: verb + object, the verb again, then the time: 坐飛機坐十六個小時.

result.traditional: 我明天要坐飛機坐十六個小時。
result.simplified: 我明天要坐飞机坐十六个小时。
result.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yào zuò fēijī zuò shíliù ge xiǎoshí.
result.english: Tomorrow I’ll be on a plane for sixteen hours.

repairs.note: 在 marks an action going on; for how long, repeat the verb: 做功課做兩個小時.

items.fallbackRepair: Pattern A: when, verb + object, the verb again, then the time: 每天做功課做兩個小時.

result.traditional: 我每天做功課做兩個小時。
result.simplified: 我每天做功课做两个小时。
result.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zuò gōngkè zuò liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
result.english: I do homework for two hours every day.

repairs.note: 得 links a verb to a comment; the time joins the object 書法課 with 的.

items.fallbackRepair: Pattern B: plan, verb, time, 的, object: 打算上一年的書法課.

result.traditional: 他打算上一年的書法課。
result.simplified: 他打算上一年的书法课。
result.pinyin: Tā dǎsuàn shàng yì nián de shūfǎ kè.
result.english: He plans to take calligraphy classes for a year.

repairs.note: 走路 is verb + object, so the time can’t follow it; split it: 走半天的路.

items.fallbackRepair: Pattern B: verb, time, 的, object: 需要走半天的路.

result.traditional: 我明天需要走半天的路。
result.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān xūyào zǒu bàntiān de lù.
result.english: Tomorrow I need to walk for half a day.

repairs.note: 上 goes with a class (上書法課); a language is studied: 學一年的日文.

items.fallbackRepair: Where first, then pattern B: 去日本學一年的日文.

result.traditional: 我決定去日本學一年的日文。
result.simplified: 我决定去日本学一年的日文。
result.pinyin: Wǒ juédìng qù Rìběn xué yì nián de Rìwén.
result.english: I’ve decided to go to Japan and study Japanese for a year.
